explication: 3D Gen Studio is an AI-assisted 3D production workspace: users manage projects, create assets through visual workflows and specialist editors, then process, assemble, and export results. The browser routes into project workspaces and tools; the backend and Python mesh service provide persistence and processing, while MCP exposes headless automation. README capabilities include image editing, graph/kanban/batch workflows, procedural buildings, trees, VFX, mesh editing, assembly fitting, and engine plugins. Several links are documented rather than source-verified; edge evidence is limited to excerpts and explicit README statements.
